title: HydraBox Subscription JWE v1
description: Strict flattened JWE JSON Serialization for one direct-encryption recipient. The protected header is validated at runtime as dir + A256GCM + hbx+jwe. This provides confidentiality and AEAD integrity, not publisher identity.

protected.description: Base64url protected JOSE header, at most 4096 decoded bytes.

ciphertext.description: Ciphertext for at most 12 MiB of uncompressed plaintext.

$comment: With alg=dir the JWE Encrypted Key is empty, so encrypted_key is absent. The v1 profile also forbids unprotected/header/aad/recipients/zip. A key hint or JWE discriminator must be handled fail-closed and never fall back to a plaintext or legacy parser. The complete outer response is limited to 16 MiB at runtime.
